Good afternoon,

I’m submitting a first notice of loss for Summit Ridge Construction Inc. under policy CPP-6612078 with Travelers Indemnity Company.

Reported loss details:
- Date of loss: 07/15/2025
- Time of loss: Approximately 2:20 PM
- Location: 9400 E Arapahoe Rd, Centennial, CO 80112
- Reported incident: A subcontractor vehicle backed into a client’s parked SUV in the project staging area, causing rear bumper and liftgate damage. No reported bodily injury at this time.

Please open a claim and advise the claim number and any next steps. Derek Olsson is the primary contact for the insured and can be reached at (303) 555-0188 or dolsson@summitridgegc.com.

Thank you,
Front Range Commercial Insurance

Note: the policy number on the attachment may be off by a digit; the correct one ends in 9.
